title: FINV: 3 of 32 on the b19 fresh never-raced gate, up from zero
status_plain: Rooting the FDIST complement form instead of the raw surface moved FINV from zero of 32 to three of 32 and collapsed a -60 ULP small-p bias to +2. The corpus is b19, which the same section establishes as fresh rows, never raced, under a held-out heading. Three of 32 is a held-out figure and it is also a very low pass rate; both facts belong in the same view.
